REV.9.7 is the precedent where an adjunct prepositional phrase and a comparative stand together, and the corpus puts a supplied copula on ὡς in nine units (1PE.1.24, REV.1.14, REV.1.16, REV.9.5, REV.9.7, REV.9.9, REV.9.17, REV.10.1, REV.20.8) and on παρά in none.
